inventory.consumable.description: Read-only projection of a consumable item, its office stock and business fingerprint

office.context.description: Read-only projection of office operational status, company, and administrative assignments

actor.assignments.description: Read-only projection of user memberships, responsibilities, and effective role slugs

document.state.description: Read-only projection of a GovStore stock or transfer document

request.progress.description: Counts of a user's submitted requests by pipeline bucket, plus draft basket line count

request.queues.description: Counts behind the navbar inbox and sidebar queue badges for one user in one office: requests awaiting primary or final approval (not their own) and approved requests awaiting fulfilment

audit.outcome.description: Read-only projection of recent audit log entries for a record

mutation.effects.description: Diagnostic check comparing baseline to current counts for isolated verification

request.state.description: Persisted state of one request by request number, including first line quantities and deciders

basket.line.description: Quantity of one catalog item in a user's draft basket

committee.visibility.description: Read-only count of committees visible to a non-company-admin office user (company and office or office-scope boundary), a search term and a committee outside that boundary

committee.record.description: A visible office committee selected for independent detail, history and print checks

committee.catalog.description: Read-only count of committee types visible to a company (national plus the company's own)

committee.mine.description: Read-only count of a user's committee tenures, and those current today (Asia/Dhaka)

organization.registry.description: Office registry scope and status-tab counts for one user (super user: every location; area ICT officer: profiled offices inside their area), a live sample office with staff, and an office outside the area

organization.office.description: One office's lifecycle status and readiness restated from the business rule (eligible staff, administrator, approver, storekeeper), next setup step, administrator, activity count and another office for boundary checks

organization.national.description: Counts behind the Administrators tabs (area ICT officers, ministry administrators) and the government directory

organization.location.description: Number of locations with exactly this name (proves a rejected form created nothing)

membership.person.description: My offices restated for one person from the membership rules: current and past offices, status and home counts, roles (with or without a pending outgoing handover), handovers waiting for them, notices, personal code and colleagues at the home office

membership.staff.description: The Staff page's tab counts for one office (staff, waiting, leaving, arriving from elsewhere in the ministry, past 12 months), the banner, first-page rows and additional staff

membership.handover.description: The latest handover of one role at one office from one person, whether that person still holds the role, and the reason recorded with its notice

membership.code.description: How many offices use an office code, normalised as people may type it (proves a code check names no office)

membership.overrides.description: Number of emergency changes in the change history

request.list.description: One requester's requests in one office with the derived request status (request_* status-map key) and the My requests tab counts (In progress, Needs you, Finished)

asset-tags.readiness.description: Asset-tagging gates G1-G6 restated from the business rules for one office (native sequence, bridge, legacy tags, office codes, single issuer, real-or-rehearsal office), the office facts, company code lists and enablement with revisions, other offices' location codes and the asset-tags access-event count

asset-tags.document.description: One store document by id: status, receiving source, challan / PO dates, lines and every tag issued for it (format, Finance Code, unit, finance source, standard reason, division and location codes, acquisition date, asset purchase date and office)

asset-tags.tag.description: Where one tag lives: registration, asset, office and company, and how many assets carry it

asset-tags.finance.description: One Finance item: status, UNSPSC link, last editor, and how many items are active

asset-tags.default.description: A product type's stored Finance Code default, its revision, owner scope and whether the type is national

rules.effective.description: Who decides one capability (default issue_govt_tags) for one office and asset model, restated from published assignments layer by layer (GLOBAL, COMPANY, LOCATION, CATEGORY, MODEL; built-in DEFAULT underneath)

rules.policy.description: One product-rules policy by exact name: status, version, lineage, behaviors and active assignments

storeops.documents.description: Store documents of one type created by one user in one office, posted documents of that type in the office, and the total number of asset registrations
